entities.name: David Špaček
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: David Špaček is a Czech–American professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Iowa Wild in the American Hockey League (AHL) as a prospect to the Minnesota Wild of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was drafted by the Wild, in the fifth round, 153rd overall, in the 2022 NHL entry draft.
